scientific_summary: Under the matched P12 Task-Aware ChatML evaluation protocol across all 180 TempUN Small cases, the TickTack-inspired baseline (adapted sinusoidal input embedding injection + attention LoRA + contrastive temporal alignment + EWC) achieves 35.19% +- 1.40% Strict Accuracy with 0.00% Invalid Rate. In contrast, M0-FC40 achieves 32.22% +- 0.00%, matching the frozen base model (32.22%). Therefore, the empirical evidence demonstrates that TickTack's direct temporal embedding injection and attention-based adaptation outperform M0-FC40's gated residual seam and MLP MaT-LoRA on this benchmark.
